description: For an occasion or a feeling (a wedding, a funeral, missing someone, autumn), the library's collections of poems in a language (all languages when none is given): title, slug, a short introduction and the link. Pick the closest and call get_collection with its slug. Collections exist in English, Russian and Belarusian.

language.description: Language of the poems, an ISO 639-1 code: en, ru, be, de, fr, es, it, pl, nl, sv, da, nb or uk.
